##### Project general facts

Harir Residences is a residential development by DAMAC Properties, inspired by the softness and fluid lines of silk. The buildings rise with curved, flowing balconies and offer one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, each with an expansive balcony and generous living spaces.

Residents enjoy separate swimming pools for men and women, a water play zone for children, indoor and outdoor gyms, a barbecue pavilion and a multipurpose sports court. Landscaped lawns with seating areas, a children's play area and dedicated workspaces complete the on-site amenities, while the wider community adds a water park, lakes, parks, retail boutiques, sports fields and a clubhouse.

Interiors feature refined finishes, large windows that bring in natural light and warm, contemporary styling. Homes come with a smart home set-up, integrated air conditioning, solar-powered water heating and round-the-clock security, supported by an on-site power substation and integrated facility management.

##### Parking

Private parking.

##### Location description and benefits

DAMAC Hills Baghdad is a master-planned community in the Iraqi capital, set near Baghdad International Airport and opposite Abbas Ibn Firnas Square. The community brings the lifestyle of the original DAMAC Hills in Dubai to Baghdad, combining secure gated living with lakes, parks and landscaped open spaces.

The area offers quick access to leading universities and the airport, while the Green Zone and the Al Mansour district are a short drive away. Prestigious educational institutions, luxury hotels, shopping centres and cultural landmarks are all within easy reach, giving residents both convenience and a calm residential setting.

The community is designed for families and professionals seeking a secure, modern neighbourhood with resort-style amenities in Baghdad. Its strategic location and comprehensive lifestyle offering make the district an attractive choice for both residents and investors.
